summary: Worker J. Smith fell from a raised platform, impacting the ground after a 450 ms free fall from an estimated height of 0.99 m. The fall was detected by the ARGUS-001 hard hat, which recorded 12.4 g peak acceleration and triggered a confirmation buzz. The worker was not wearing fall protection equipment during the fall.

clip_refs.observation: Fall detected: 450 ms of free fall (estimated drop 0.99 m) ending in an impact of 12.4 g.
Confirmation buzz on both motors (1.5 s) to tell the wearer the event was recorded.

evidence.environment: Near-wearer conditions (indicative): CO2 612 ppm, temperature 21.4 C, relative humidity 38%.

hazard.energy_source: gravitational potential energy converted to kinetic energy during free fall

risk.severity_justification: The worker fell from a height of 0.99 m, which is sufficient to cause serious injury or death if impact forces are not mitigated.
risk.likelihood_justification: The worker was observed preparing to descend the platform, indicating a foreseeable risk, but no fall protection was used.

immediate.description: Worker did not use fall protection equipment while working on an elevated surface.
No fall protection system or guardrails were visible on the platform.

root_five_whys: Why did the worker fall? Because he stepped off the platform without fall protection.
Why was fall protection not used? Because it was not provided or required by site procedures.
Why was it not provided? Because the site supervisor did not enforce fall protection requirements.
Why did the supervisor not enforce it? Because there was no documented fall protection policy or training.
Why was there no policy or training? Because the site safety plan was not fully implemented or reviewed.

corrective_actions.description: Implement and enforce a fall protection policy for all elevated work.
Install guardrails or fall arrest systems on all elevated platforms.
Provide mandatory fall protection training for all workers and supervisors.
Conduct regular inspections to ensure fall protection systems are in place and functional.
Review and update the site safety plan to include fall protection requirements.
